items.title: More Fake Mastodon Signups
items.summary: On 2026-05-30, the Mastodon server I run started getting a flood of implausible signup requests. items.title: Getting Paid by Flat Rate Movers
items.summary: Back in 2023, I hired Flat Rate Movers (A.K.A. Flat Rate Moving) for an interstate move.
